ctg.plugin.title: Create Track Generator
ctg.plugin.description: Generates Create Mod track model sets from left/right rail and tie parts: gauge with mm/inch conversion, optional portal textures, 11 track shapes, and 4-mode export (new/classic Java, Bedrock, OBJ).
ctg.plugin.about:
"Tools" → "Generate Create Tracks":
1. Pick the three parts: Left Rail / Right Rail / Tie (import a .bbmodel, or "Select a Tab" to extract the elements selected in an open tab)
2. The right rail can be chosen directly, or "Mirror from First Model" to derive it from the left rail
3. Enter the track gauge (px, Create default 1600mm ≈ 25.6px), track height, whole-model Y offset and a new workspace name
4. Optionally import portal_track (covers the teleport track/ties) and portal_track_mip (generates the teleport_left / teleport_right overlay blocks)
5. Generates the 11 track shapes + the tie / segment_left / segment_right curve base groups into a new workspace, applying the part textures
6. All three parts must share the same texture resolution; any part with mesh groups makes the workspace a generic model, otherwise Java block/item

"Tools" → "Export Track Models": exports the current workspace's track group in 4 modes (1.21.11+ new Java / classic Java / Bedrock / all OBJ) to a chosen folder, with blockstates + texture PNGs. Unexportable shapes fall back to OBJ; OBJ is a single merged mesh. Model and texture resource paths are customizable.

"Tools" → "Track Gauge Converter": enter the gauge to get the Create curve scale constant.
  Anchors: 1435mm→0.755, 1600mm→0.965, 1000mm→0.525 (quadratic fit)

ctg.action.export.name: Export Track Models
ctg.action.export.desc: Export the track group of the current workspace as Create/Kuayue-named models + blockstates + textures to a chosen folder
ctg.action.example_rail.name: Generate Example Rail

ctg.gauge.hint: Enter inches / mm / px — the other two update automatically. The scale constant is fitted from the px gauge (1 block = 1000 mm = 16 px).

ctg.export.title: Export Track Models
ctg.export.mode.desc: Shapes that cannot be exported automatically fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.namespace.desc: Resource pack namespace (model / blockstates path prefix), e.g. kuayue, create, mymod.
ctg.export.track_id.desc: Model folder name and blockstates file name (standard / track / meter …).
ctg.export.loader.desc: Loader prefix in the OBJ reference JSON (forge → "loader": "forge:obj"). Fill in your mod loader (forge, neoforge, …).
ctg.export.root.desc: The folder containing assets/{namespace}; all files are written here under models/ textures/ blockstates/.
ctg.export.model_path.desc: Resource path for referencing models from blockstates ({namespace}:path/file). Default block/track/{track id}; models written to root/models/{path}/.
ctg.export.textures_hint: One resource path per texture for referencing from models ({namespace}:path/file). Default block/track/{track id}; textures written to root/textures/{path}/.
ctg.export.no_textures: No textures found in the track group.
ctg.export.empty_ns_id: The namespace and track id must not be empty.
ctg.export.invalid_chars: The namespace and track id may only contain lowercase letters, digits and underscores (Minecraft resource location requirement).
ctg.export.invalid_loader: The mod loader may only contain lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
ctg.export.empty_paths: The export root, model resource path and texture resource paths must not be empty.
ctg.export.invalid_resource_path: Resource paths may only contain lowercase letters, digits and / _ . -, and must not start or end with a slash, or contain "..".
ctg.export.no_fs: Unable to write to the file system: no permission to access the selected folder.
ctg.export.no_obj_codec: The Blockbench OBJ exporter (Codecs.obj) is not available in this environment.

Blockstates: %2

ctg.workspace.create_fail: Unable to create a new workspace (invalid model format)
ctg.export.mode.new_java.label: 1.21.11+ New Java Block/Item Model
ctg.export.mode.new_java.desc: format_version 1.21.11; multi-axis rotation {x,y,z}; mesh shapes fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.mode.classic_java.label: 1.21.11- Classic Java Block/Item Model
ctg.export.mode.classic_java.desc: No format_version (matches assets examples); single-axis rotation {angle,axis} only; multi-axis / mesh shapes fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.mode.bedrock.label: Bedrock Block Model
ctg.export.mode.bedrock.desc: One minecraft:geometry + blocks.json per shape; mesh / multi-texture shapes fall back to OBJ.
ctg.export.mode.obj.label: Export Everything as OBJ
ctg.export.mode.obj.desc: All cubes / meshes baked into a single merged mesh (Forge-loader-readable).
ctg.export.mode.forced_obj_hint: Generic/free model: its origin-centered geometry can't be expressed with Java / Bedrock block formats, so only OBJ export is allowed.
ctg.export.mode.forced_obj_note: OBJ export was forced: the current workspace is a generic/free model.
